question: Does a branch with a higher preregistered pairwise non-additive response score preferentially transmit a held-out probe while its matched lower-score branch is suppressed?
claim_scope: Prepared memory comparison only; not an autonomously written-memory router, physical light or a model-level principle of maximizing complexity.

geometry.outlets: Two nodes origin+(-6,0,0) and origin+(6,0,0), all48channels monitored.
geometry.horizon: Calibration9; held-out, isolated-arm and joint no-source15
geometry.periodic_wrap_exclusion: Initial nonbackground support margin29 exceeds longest horizon15.

variable_memory.variant_definition: Set both selected channel0 remainders to v; all counters remain0.
variable_memory.intervention: For separate initial preparations only, flip selected r to (r+2) mod6 at i, j or both.

calibration.output: Flatten signed b counters in order(t=6..9,g=0..47) at the tested outlet, 192 exact integers; no thresholding or channel selection.
calibration.score: K_side(v)=1 iff vector Yij-Yi-Yj+Ynone is nonzero; otherwise0. Since m=2 this is one pair, not a rich or universal complexity measure.
calibration.score_freeze: Complete and save all six K_side(v) scores and their exact vectors before computing any held-out selection verdict.

heldout.no_source_control: Same complete memory preparation, source origin counters allzero, remainders unchanged.
heldout.output: All48 b counters at each outlet for t10..15 (288 exact signed integers per outlet), using exact probe-absent subtraction. Also retain a counters and complete states. Report early t6..9 activation separately, never count it as late cancellation.
heldout.eligible_prediction: K_left(v_left) != K_right(v_right). Tied scores yield no directional prediction and are reported as ties, not successes or failed directional predictions.
heldout.strict_pass: The higher-K outlet has at least one nonzero probe-induced b difference; every probe-induced b difference at the lower-K outlet is exactlyzero in the complete fixed window.
heldout.failures: Report low-K-only transmission, both transmitting, both quiet, timing failure and ties separately. Do not retain only successful ordered pairs.
heldout.aggregate_prediction: The strict higher-K-only prediction must hold for every eligible held-out probe comparison. If there are no eligible comparisons, the directional hypothesis is unresolved. One contrary eligible comparison refutes this finite universal prediction.
heldout.prepared_state_control: Opposite ordered variant pairs are explicit memory-swap controls; both arm directions are directly simulated rather than inferred from an assumed reflection symmetry.
heldout.isolation_preparations: For each arm side(-1,+1), each memoryvariant(0,2,4), and probe(P1,P2), keep that arm and set all channels of the other arm to the background(0,0,2). Keep the origin source and same tensor unchanged. All comparisons use recorded complete states through15.
heldout.isolation_no_source_baseline: No extra runs are claimed. The corresponding all-zero-counter isolated apparatus is exactly stationary by Rule3 for arbitrary valid remainder fields; its output-counter baseline is exactlyzero by this proof.
heldout.causal_timing: A changed remainder at armj2 cannot change b before sourcearrivalt2 and then must cross8links to oppositeoutlet, earliestt10. Forj3 earliestt3+9=t12. These bounds concern these quiet initial preparations, not all possible models.

matching.counter_budget: No apparatus counters initially nonzero; within each held-out run both arms receive the same source with totalinitialcounterL1=4. CalibrationP0 has L1=2 and is deliberately distinct from both held-out probes.
matching.remaining_difference: The predeclared remainder memory variants and any existing directional response of the fixed tensor; evaluate both directions and both ordered variants.

cancellation.input_cancellation_witness: Additionally identify an update of a low-K outlet channel in the fixed latewindow with joint olda=oldb=0, sum of six signed neighbor b terms=0, and sum(abs(terms))>0. Require corresponding isolated-run netu!=0 and isolated nextb!=0 while joint nextb=0, and retain allterms/ell/a for both runs. Without such a witness call the result finite-window suppression, not demonstrated input cancellation.
cancellation.counter_update_caveat: Even an input-cancellation witness does not itself prove a whole path disappeared; output b_next also depends on old a. Retain ell,old a and the complete update.
cancellation.suppression: Zero probe-induced output in the observation window means only finite-window suppression at that monitor. Off-output information remains in the complete reversible state.
cancellation.counterfactual_suppression: Require a low-K output with nonzero probe-induced b in its matched isolated-arm control duringt10..15 but allzero probe-induced b in the joint run during the samewindow. Record both vectors and do not infer erasure of any earlier response.
cancellation.strong_pass: The higher-K-only selection predicate, isolated-versus-joint low-output suppression, and at least one input-cancellation witness all hold in that declared comparison. Report how many comparisons meet each condition separately.

verification.complete_rendering: Use existing generic Presenter; no per-experiment rendering or state mutation.

budget.updates_per_run: 24calibration×9 +30other×15 =666forwardupdates, plus exact inverse and rewind audits
budget.budget_exhaustion: inconclusive; retain completed prefix and exactstopreason, no claim on unexecuted comparisons

interpretation.positive: A reproducible finite correlation for these prepared branches/probes, subject to the fixed matched controls; not a physical selection law.
interpretation.negative: A counterexample to this precise K-based preference prediction or an uninformative tied calibration; not a theorem excluding all complexity metrics or all routable devices.
interpretation.registration_scope: Frozen in this working session before these runs, not externally timestamped preregistration.
interpretation.off_axis_routes: The fixed arms are prepared corridors, not exclusive transport channels. Full 3D transverse ports and off-corridor state remain in every exact trajectory. An outlet response does not prove all influence traveled along its drawn arm.

revision_reason: Before any calibration or probe run, independent causal review found selected-site influence cannot reach opposite outlet before t10/t12; extend held-out horizon/window and add isolated-arm controls.
